QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] A Friend of the People
QuestInfo.0: You're on the job in Edelstein. Listen to 10 Boogies.
QuestInfo.1: The townspeople might be less standoffish if they get to know you. Try approaching them. Start with the one in the bear suit.
QuestInfo.2: They seem suspicious of foreigners. Hopefully, they haven't figured out that you're a Cygnus Knight too.

default.0: If you make friends with the locals, they might be willing to share information with you. Why not strike up a conversation with the person in the #bbear suit#k, in the town square?\r\n
